summary: 1934 L-4 cab near Marion Lake, Willamette NF; removed c.1964-65. A hiking guide describes a viewpoint called Marion Mountain and says it is not Marion Peak to the south; the sources do not confirm it is the register site.

facts.status_note: The cab was removed around 1964 or 1965. No source describes what remains on the ground today.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

access.note: Inferred from the hiking guide, which describes a trail hike to the site and mentions no closure or permit. No Forest Service page was read for this site.

visit.trail_note: About 9 miles and 1,100 ft of climbing from the Pine Ridge Trailhead, per Oregon Hikers; the guide calls its viewpoint Marion Mountain, and the sources do not confirm that it is the register site

events.note: L-4 cab. Register, Kamstra and Kemnow all give 1934
Kemnow dates the removal to about 1964
Register says gone by 1965; Kamstra says gone 1965

evidence.supports: L-4 cab built 1934 about a mile SW of Marion Lake; gone by 1965
evidence.quote: Built in 1934 one mile SW of Marion Lake near the north end of the spur below the summit, this L-4 cab was gone by 1965.

evidence.supports: site in the Willamette National Forest

evidence.quote: 1934: A 14 x 14 L-4 lookout house was constructed.

evidence.supports: Marion Mountain is a former fire lookout site with a view over the Mt. Jefferson Wilderness
evidence.quote: is a former fire lookout site with a view over the Mt. Jefferson Wilderness

evidence.supports: hike of about 9 miles and 1,100 ft of climbing
hike starts at the Pine Ridge Trailhead
guide warns the site is not Marion Peak to the south
evidence.quote: not to be confused with Marion Peak just to the south

sources.title: Marion Mountain - Forest Lookouts (PDF copy)
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (Ron Kemnow), copy at orww.org

notes_for_editor: Name conflict: the register calls this Marion Peak; the hiking guide calls the viewpoint Marion Mountain and says it is not Marion Peak to the south. The register coordinates in the record (44.54775, -121.8804) are within about 10 m of the guide's point (44.54774, -121.88047), so the editor should confirm whether the register site is the Marion Mountain viewpoint. Removal date conflicts: c.1964 (Kemnow) versus 1965 (register, Kamstra). The register's FFLOS registration date (May 11, 2011, from the record) was not checked on the page. No staffing or fire sources found. Access is inferred from the hiking guide only.
